description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'FingerprintUiHelper' for managing fingerprint authentication UI elements in an Android app. It includes inner builder class, callback handling, and methods for starting/stopping listening, and updating UI based on authentication results.

classes.name: FingerprintUiHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage fingerprint authentication UI components and callbacks, including starting/stopping listening, handling success/error, and UI updates.

classes.name: FingerprintUiHelperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of FingerprintUiHelper with dependency injection support.

methods.name: isFingerprintAuthAvailable
methods.description: Checks if fingerprint hardware is available and fingerprints are enrolled.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Initiates fingerprint authentication listening session with provided cryptographic object.

methods.name: onAuthenticationError
methods.description: Handles authentication error events and triggers error UI updates.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful authentication, updates UI, and triggers callback.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Updates UI to show an error message and icon.
